page.layout: One page of text in a decorative border; running head and page number at the top; a small marginal mark "N" (a handwritten or printed sign, no text) at right beside the text. No notes in the margin block. Text runs in one column from top to bottom; no catchword.

main_text.p: ctionem ipsius omnigenam. Aut subito aufugit, resolvens sespiritua-liter in oleum incombustibile; aut manet post sui fixationem constans, ita ut hominum nulli possibile sit ali-quid ei adimere: tantum eoúsq; quid quid ex auro fieri potest, id ex ipso quoq; potest confici per artem. Nam post rectam sui coagulationem auro per omnia similis est: quandoquidem cum auro exuna radice, unoq; stipite, & ex unitate provenit. Cum his consentit, quæ idem sparsim habet de astro Solis & spiritu sive astro Mercurii, quæ duo radiola virium potestate conjuncta sapientiæ in-timæ penetralia certo tempore a-periunt. Vide currum Triumpha-lem pag. 71 & 72 nec non pag. 91. & 92. Quod si à nonnullis Tractatus Basilii de astro Solis & Mercurii, quorum

page.notes: The first lines are cut at the left edge of the frame; "ctionem" is probably "actionem" [?]. Marginal mark "N" at right is a handwritten or printed sign and is not transcribed. Several words in the italic passage are underlined in the print and are kept as italic. Text of the left-hand page edge (fragmentary ruled text) is not transcribed.
